title: RecusalRecord
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.casework.RecusalRecord). Framework hard invariant 53: recusal blocks capability WITHOUT erasing history - `prior_participation_codes` preserves what the recused actor already did, and nothing removes those acts. Framework hard invariant 54: assessments are versioned, not overwritten - a superseding assessment names the one it supersedes via `supersedes_recusal_id`. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
